_comment: Recorded judge responses keyed by 'rule|matched' or 'rule|matched|sentence'. Used so tests and dry runs never call the API. Keys are casefolded.

R-002|side effect|tell your care team ab.revised_sentence: Tell your care team about any side effect you notice.
R-002|side effect|tell your care team ab.justification: The sentence addresses the patient directly, so the readability-tested plain-language term is correct here.

R-002|side effect|investigators recorded.revised_sentence: Investigators recorded each adverse event observed during the study period.
R-002|side effect|investigators recorded.justification: This is a clinical evaluation context where the regulatory term is required.

R-010|nurse|the nurse practitioner revie.revised_sentence: The nurse practitioner reviews the order.
R-010|nurse|the nurse practitioner revie.justification: The text names a specific nursing credential rather than a general clinician task.
